title: Nairobi National Museum – National Museums of Kenya

facts.fact: Permanent galleries include human origins, mammals, Kenyan history, cycles of life, numismatics and Asian African heritage.
facts.evidenceExcerpt: The Cradle of human kind gallery; The Story of mammals; The History of Kenya; Cycles of life gallery; Numismatic exhibition and Asian African Heritage exhibition gallery

facts.fact: The human origins gallery includes early human material and Stone Age tools; Kenyan history includes colonialism and independence.
facts.evidenceExcerpt: early man and Stone Age tools ... colonial period ... struggle for independence

facts.fact: The museum is located at Museum Hill.
